title: Boat band personnel and guitar versus banjo
summary: Names the players on the Piron boat band, discusses guitar without amplifier, preference for guitar or banjo, his trumpet and family instruments.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. I remember all those boats. Who was all in the band?

During that time, Leo Dejean, Joe Phillips, Eddie Pearson. Oh, yeah. And Eddie Pearson. And it was trombone. And saxophone was Louis Cartrell, Oscar Rouson, and Elliot Taylor. On the drums was Sidney Montague, Booker, Booker Washington on bass, Lewis Gibbons on piano, and I was playing the straight guitar.
Any electric guitar in those days?
Well, not on the boat, because, I mean, you could get an amplifier built for that AC and DC current.
Yeah, DC, I remember.
Yes. But I didn't have that. I just had a straight regular guitar.
You like guitar or banjo best?
Well, both of them's good if you can play them.
Yeah.
And I wish I could play either one of them.
Sounds all right to me. Yeah. The one you make the most money with, that's the best one.
That's the best one. Right. Seemed like the Badger is making the most money right now.
Yeah. It's back popular again. Popular. Yeah. In the small Dixieland bands and all. I was going to ask about the other instruments, what else you took up in the late years in the brass band. Yeah.
Well, I had a trumpet. I have a trumpet around and I kind of play a couple of tunes or so on it.
I heard you out on a parade.
Not too good, but the trumpet.
I don't know about it. I understand. You can't be good on everything. That's right. Some practices played that. Yeah. That's right. Yeah. Notice the bass drum and all here in the room here. Did you?
No. That belonged to my sons. They played.
Your brothers never played the drums. No. I never played the drums. The piano? Anybody in your family played the piano?
My little boy played the piano. My little boy played the piano.
My little boy played the piano.
My little boy played the piano.
